description: This file is a shell script designed for handling crash and minidump uploads on a device. It manages locating dump files, packaging them, and uploading to remote servers such as S3 or Crash Portal, with support for rate limiting, blacklists, and retries. The script also handles lock mechanisms to prevent concurrent runs, performs environment checks, and maintains upload rate policies.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Sets log filename based on device info and core dump details to maintain consistent logging structure.

methods.name: logStdout
methods.description: Logs standard output lines to the core log with timestamps.

methods.name: create_lock_or_exit
methods.description: Creates a lock directory or exits if lock exists to prevent concurrent script runs.

methods.name: create_lock_or_wait
methods.description: Creates a lock directory or waits until it can be created, used for synchronization.

methods.name: remove_lock
methods.description: Removes the lock directory to release the lock.

methods.name: logMessage
methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and process ID to the core log file.

methods.name: tlsLog
methods.description: Logs TLS-related errors to a dedicated TLS error log.

methods.name: isBuildBlacklisted
methods.description: Downloads blacklist file and checks if current build version is blacklisted.

methods.name: logUploadTimestamp
methods.description: Logs the current timestamp (seconds since epoch) to a timestamp file for rate limiting.

methods.name: truncateTimeStampFile
methods.description: Keeps only the last 10 timestamps in the timestamp file for crash rate limiting.

methods.name: isUploadLimitReached
methods.description: Checks if too many dumps have been uploaded in the last 10 minutes for rate limiting.

methods.name: setRecoveryTime
methods.description: Sets a recovery timestamp 10 minutes in the future to pause uploads after failure or limit reached.

methods.name: isRecoveryTimeReached
methods.description: Checks whether the recovery time has passed to resume uploads.

methods.name: removePendingDumps
methods.description: Deletes queued dump files when upload rate limit has been exceeded.

methods.name: markAsCrashLoopedAndUpload
methods.description: Renames a dump file to indicate crash loop and uploads it to crash portal.

methods.name: downloadBlacklist
methods.description: Downloads and updates a blacklist of version names that are not supported for crash uploads.

methods.name: get_crashed_log_file
methods.description: Identifies and logs files related to a crashed process.

methods.name: add_crashed_log_file
methods.description: Adds log files associated with a crash to the upload list, truncating them appropriately.

methods.name: shouldProcessFile
methods.description: Determines if a specific dump file should be processed based on build type and filename.

methods.name: processDumps
methods.description: Processes dump files: packages, logs, and uploads them using a rate-limited and retry mechanism.

methods.name: uploadToS3
methods.description: Signs and uploads dump files to Amazon S3, handling encryption and TLS configurations.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Performs cleanup actions and releases locks on script termination.

methods.name: sigkill_function
methods.description: Handles SIGKILL to clean up before process termination.

methods.name: sigterm_function
methods.description: Handles SIGTERM for graceful shutdown and cleanup.

methods.name: is_box_rebooting
methods.description: Checks if the box is in the process of rebooting to skip upload.
